picks.headline: FTC asked to investigate destruction of books
picks.excerpt: More than a dozen groups have asked the Federal Trade Commission to look at the scanning and destruction of physical books for AI model training.
picks.rationale: A new regulatory event — a dozen-plus groups formally petitioning the FTC — rather than another retelling of the Amazon VGT3 scanning exposé already published on 08-28.

picks.headline: How Claude watermarking works: Some accuse Anthropic of compliance theatre
picks.excerpt: Commentators find it problematic that the watermark is applied when Claude is used for assistive tasks rather than purely generative ones — a distinction that matters for writers who use AI to edit.
picks.rationale: Goes past the bare announcement already covered on 08-27 and explains the mechanism plus the 'compliance theatre' critique — directly actionable for anyone who uses Claude to edit rather than generate.

picks.headline: AI-generated books are flooding Amazon and tanking sales for human authors
picks.excerpt: A new market study of the Amazon/Kindle catalog finds AI-assisted titles diluting the whole market: between Q1 2023 and Q1 2026 the catalog grew 38.3x while quarterly revenue grew only 8.9x. Books with no detected AI text are 62.9% of the catalog but 72.5% of revenue, while substantially-AI books are 20% of titles and 11.3% of revenue.
picks.rationale: Hard numbers on catalog-wide revenue dilution that self-publishers can act on; distinct from the Originality.AI religion-paperback detection study published 08-21.

picks.headline: 읽던 웹툰이 말을 걸었다…'보는 만화' 틀 깬 네이버웹툰
picks.excerpt: 네이버웹툰이 원작자 승인 IP를 기반으로 독자가 웹툰 주인공과 직접 대화하는 AI 스토리챗 '바이어스(byUs)'와 AI 숏폼 제작 서비스 '컷츠메이크'를 전개하며 웹툰 소비 방식 자체를 바꾸고 있다. 휴재 중이던 '이직로그'는 AI 서비스 적용 후 일주일 만에 조회수가 67% 증가했다.
picks.rationale: The only shipped-product story in the pool — creator-approved IP turned into interactive AI story chat with a measured 67% view lift, and the only Korean-market angle in five days of books history.

picks.headline: When bots write books
picks.excerpt: A survey of how generative AI is being folded into book production — from drafting to the flood of machine-written titles reaching retail — and what that shift means for human authors, editors and the shape of the publishing pipeline.
picks.rationale: A step-back map of where AI now sits in the production pipeline, giving the week's individual scanning/watermarking/slop stories a single frame; no equivalent overview in the last five days.
